tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// war+ṣabherīrunāmaratībidzayadwipadewagṛhas+yapretibim+bakṛtādāram+bhas+yasaṃgītibidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// dga' ldan rnam rgyal gling du rten bzhengs pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba dbyar gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// yaḥ.abhikāmas+ya.ārohanamatreṇa/ dh+yāyaphalāyar+thatsin+tāmaṇidānas+t+waṃ/ wārasamāṇāt+sakhānastibh+waweṣ+wan+ya/ t+pālayatsakras+yanāthaish+sharaṇaṃnit+yaṃ// ༄༅// gang zhig mngon 'dod gsol ba btab tsam gyis// bsam don snying po ster khyod yid bzhin nor// mtshungs las zla gzhan srid na mchis min pa// skyabs mchog 'khor lo'i mgon gyis rtag tu srungs// dpag yas tshogs zung dag byed gter nyid smon lam dri khyer gyis bsrubs pas// dge mtshan dpe byad nor bu'i rang bzhin srid gsum zla bral mngon par 'phags// spangs rtogs yon tan snang byed mched kyis legs gsungs snang ba ring spros pas// 'gro snying ma rig 'thib bu'i mun 'phrog sangs rgyas ri dbang la phyag 'tshal// de gsungs dri med 'jig rten snang phyir ston mchog rang gi sgyu 'phrul gar// gnas lnga rig smra brda 'gyur gnyis su 'doms pa'i tshul gyis kha ba'i ljongs// sngon med chos kyi snang chen 'gyed po 'phags pa'i yul dang bho ṭa'i ljongs// gang dag byon pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyi bka' drin snying nas bsams kyin dad// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob spyod pa dpag yas rin chen 'byung gnas chen po nyid// byang chub snying po mngon 'dod bloṃ bzaṃng brtson 'grus gnyid bral dbang po'i tshogs// smon pa'i gnas mchog lhun pos bsrubs skyes gragaṃs pa'iṃ dpal gyi nyin mor byed// phrin las ngur smrig 'chang ba'i dmar 'od srid mthar brgal ba'i btsong kha pa// 'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs 'khor ba mtha' can du// ma gyur de srid 'jig rten phan bde'i rtsa lag tu// brtan brling byed pa bslab gsum lhur len 'dus pa'i tshogs// yang dag bstan pa'i bshad sgrub kho nar rag las phyir// de dag chos spyod mthun pa'i kun dga' rwar// klog spong 'khor lo zung gis dus 'bar ba// 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i chu mtshor ngang ngur tshogs// mgrin snyan 'phur lding gis rtsen bzhin du mdzes// 'on te dge 'dun 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang*// gsar bskrun la brten srog chags 'tshe ba'i las// 'gyur sogs sdig pa'i rgyu phyir spang bya nyid// 'khyog por smra ba mur 'dug gcer bu'i lugs// dge 'dun 'du ba'i kun dga' rwa ba dang*// rten gsum bskrun pa'i bsod nams dpag yas su// 'phel bar 'gyur zhes ston mchog nyi ma'i gnyen// yan lag rdzogs pa'i gdangs kyis mngon par bsngags// rnam bkra brgya byin tshon ris lta byed kyi// yul du mtshungs las rgyal ba'i bka' lung gis// nyer bstan drang thig las bton sku gzugs kyi// mtshan du rdzogs pas khyad par che ba gang*// gus pa lhur bgyid spro ba'i 'grogs bshes dag

/dngos rgyu gus sbyor mthun rkyen sbyor bar bcas// rang nyid ltos bcas bsod nams tshogs phyir dang*// chos dang chos mdzad 'dus tshogs rgyas phyir bskrun// lus phra'i glu dang bsres pa'i tam+bu raḥ// 'khrol ba'i dbyangs snyan sgra 'dzin bcud len na// rten gsum bskrun las brtsams pa dge ba'i mchid// snying po can 'dir rna bar lhogs shig gu// de'ang thams cad mkhyen pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa rin po che dar bar lung bstan pa'i yul 'khor chen po rnams kyi nang nas bod chen por grags pa'i ljongs/ skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun la co 'drir bzod pa'i 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma'i rgyun chen dal gyis g.yo zhing 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs/ thub bstan chos 'khor gling zhes grags pa zhwa lu legs pa rgyal mtshan pa'i dngos slob/ nyag re rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas legs par btab pa'i gdan sa chen po gang dang nye ba'i srib smad ces pa'i nor 'dzin ma'i char 'khod kyi chos sde dga' ldan rnam rgyal dgon zhes bod pa/ gser zhun cod paṇa 'chang ba'i ring lugs kyi rjes su sgrub pa'i 'dus sdes nye bar bsten pa'i bsti gnas su gyur pa gtsug lag khang ngam/ lha khang sngar yod pa rgas gogs su song ba nyams gsos dang*/ nang du ldebs bris med par/ dgon sde der bzhugs kyi grwa rigs rnams kyi mos 'dun yod par/ rnam par dpyod ldan 'tsho byed pa blo bzang shes rab kyis sbyin bdag tshag len 'gan 'degs lhan cig pas dngos rdzas phan 'dogs gang nus dang*/ gzhan dang gzhan dag nas kyang dngos rdzas zang zing gi zhal 'debs byung bar brten/ lha khang gi bzo bcos zhal ba bcas dang nang logs sgo khang dang bcas pa'i ldebs bris gsar bskrun bcas legs par grub pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba la bzhi ste/ rten bzheng gi dgos pa/ der rten ji ltar bskrun pa/ bskrun pa'i rten gyi bzhugs grangs/ bzhengs pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o// dang po ni rang re rnams tshe rabs gtan gyi lu gu rgyud nas bsags pa'i legs byas kyi skyed byed dam pas 'phangs pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus rten thob nas/

rnam 'dren bstan pa'i khang bzang dam pa'i 'jug sgo so sor thar pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa gsum ste/ de dag thams cad kyi thog ma'i rtsom byed dam gzhi ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du 'gro ba can min pa ni 'ga' yang med pa'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas de'i bslab bya sdom pa dang dam tshig gi tshogs la bsrung sdom bgyid pa dang*/ dkon mchog gi rten bzheng ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba la shin tu 'bad par bya dgos te/ de las lhag par gyur pa'i bya ba gzhan 'ga' yang bsgrub tu yod pa ma yin te/ mdo sde rgyal mtshan dam pa las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas chos dang ni// dge 'dun dag la skyabs 'gro ba// skyabs de la ni brten nas kyang*// sdug bsngal sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang*// sdug bsngal yang dag 'gags pa dang*// bde gzhi mya ngan 'das byas nas// sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang*// 'jigs tshogs theg pa dman pa las// thabs ma yin dang ngan song las// bskyab phyir skyabs kyi dam pa yin// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i bslab bya la'ang mdo dang sngags gzhung rnams las ji skad bstan pa ltar spyi dang so so'i bslab bya rnams la nan tan gyis bslab pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi 'dod pa sgrub pa dang*/ mi 'dod pa bsal ba thams cad dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad cing gsol ba btab pa dang*/ lus dang longs spyod kyi sgo nas dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thags kyi rten bzheng ba dang*/ rten la phyag mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ tha na'ang chu gtsang khyor ba re yang dkon mchog mchod par dmigs nas 'bul ba la bslab dgos te/ cis phyir zhe na/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bdun bcu pa las/ sangs rgyas de chos dge 'dun ni// thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs// zhes gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bar gyi don thams cad de dag la brten nas sgrub dgos pa dang*/

rang rgyud kyi sdig pa sbyang zhing*/ ye shes kyi tshogs stong pa nyid rtogs pa la'ang bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa la rag las te/ mdo sdud pa las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma rdzogs bar// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi byed// ces so// tshogs bsags pa la'ang gtso bor yul dag pa dkon mchog gsum la brten nas sgrub dgos pa'i phyir/ tshul de ltar shes nas dkon mchog gsum gyi bzhugs gnas gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa dang*/ sku gzugs dang*/ glegs bam dang*/ mchod rten bzhengs pa rnams ni rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi dngos po bdun du bshad de/ 'dul ba lung rnam 'byed las/ kun dga' rwa ba gtsug lag khang*// mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang*// zhes sogs gsungs so// khyad par mchod rten zhes pa ni spyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum ka la 'jug par bshad pas/ de dag bzhengs pas sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba phrag du ma dang bcas pa la lo grangs dpag tu med par yo byad kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mtshon gang pa ring bsrel gyi snying po can bskrun pa la bsod nams mang du mnos par 'gyur ba/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni// sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci yod pa// de 'dra'i grangs de snyed kyi rgyal srid dang*// lha yul sa steng mi yis nges par thob// gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myangs nas// tha mar skye dang rga ba la sogs pa'i// sdug bsngal dang bral sangs rgyas go 'phang thob// ces dang*/ rgyu sde gong 'og kun du bris sku la sogs pa sgrub tshul dgos pa dang bcas te rgyas par gsungs pa rnams dang*/ de bzhin du gsung rten glegs bam bzhengs pa'i bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob pa'ang*/

'phags pa sdud pa las/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na// sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul nas// gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te// sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ba dang*/ yang mchod rten bzhengs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel ba yang*/ la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yi// zhes pa nas/ mchod rten byas pa'i bsod nams char mi phod// ces dang*/ gong gi gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa sogs las rgya cher 'byung ba'i phyir ro// smras pa/ skyabs su bsten tsam srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las// skyob byed mkhyen brtse'i phyag rgya ring rkyong ba// dpag yas yon tan mtshungs kyang nges legs kyi// snye ma sbyin pas khyad 'phags dkon mchog gsum// rgyal ba'i phrin las gzugs rnams rten gsum gyi// rnam par shar de bskrun pa'i legs byas mtha'// kun gsal 'dom pas ma chings stong pa'i brdzur// nges par zhugs snyam gad mo 'brug tu dgod// chos kyi bshad sgrub phrin las rgyas phyir dang*// 'jig rten bde legs gzhon nu 'gugs phyir dang*// rang gzhan mtshan bzang sgrub pa'i sa bon du// rten gsum bskrun pa'i skal ba ches cher sbom// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// gnyis pa der rten ji ltar bskrun pa la bzhi ste/ rten bskrun pa'i bdag rkyen pa/ grogs las byed bsags pa/ las kyi 'go brtsams dus/ brtsams pa grub pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ ji ltar smos pa'i dgos don gyi snying pos yid dbang dge ba'i phyogs su drangs nas dgon pa'i spyi so'i dpyod ldan rnams dang*/ las kyi bkod pa 'gan 'degs bcas par blo gros gsal zhing*/ rig pa'i gtsug lag 'dzin pa blo bzang shes rab can gyis bgyis te/ lha khang gi bzo bcos dang zhal ba gsar bcos nas bzung ste do dam khur len gzung ba/

de la dngos rdzas kyi 'brel 'jog bgyid pa'i sbyin bdag gi tshogs rnams nas zhal 'debs 'byung ba la/ thog mar mchog gi sprul sku ngag dbang phrin las pa nas dngul srang bzhi/ lho pa bla mas dar kha/ chos gos/ mdzo bcas/ rdza bkram bla ma nas/ gser zho/ 'khar tir/ ba mo'i phyed shas/ chos 'khor dpon gyis ja sbags/ ra kho dpon gyis ja sbags/ dar kha/ gro khal gnyis/ ga'u/ rtogs ldan ja khag sbags phyed gnyis/ yar 'gags bla mas snyug shubs/ dung phreng*/ dung chab/ ya thar mar rgya do/ 'bu dpon nas khal gnyis/ yar gling bas ja sbags/ g.yag ra bzhi/ blo bzang chos ldan gyis byi ru srang gang lhag gser skar gsum/ phyar gos/ dge 'dun chos grags dar kha/ ras cha/ tha mi ka gnyis/ ja sbags/ ye shes lhun grub dang gnyis kas wa lpags/ dar rgyas rta srab/ rin chen skyabs ja gdum/ dung gi pang shar/ gse nas sgra 'then dung chab/ blo bzang bstan pa ja gdum/ tha me ka gcig don grub rgya mtsho tshwa zo/ a mdo mar rgya/ blo bzang rgya mtsho ba/ lha srung dar kha/ ra gnyis tha mi ka lnga/ ye shes tshe ring ja sbags/ rdzi ba ra dngul bal dong phyed lnga/ ja sbags/ rin chen 'tsho ba rgan/ zhing khre'u/ blo bzang chos skyid gro khal phyed/ snam bu/ lha 'tsho nas khal bzhi/ yar skyid mdzo mo/ ja sbags gnyis/ nas khal gsum/ bkra shis skyid gser skar lnga/ dgon pa spyi ba nas mdzo/ g.yag gnyis/ ral gri/ gro khal gsum/ gra mangs nas nas khal phyed lnga sogs mchis pa rnams te/ nye bar mkho ba'i nyer bsdogs thams cad tshang bar bstar ro// gnyis pa la spyir gyi byung ba brjod pa dang*/ bye brag tu bkar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag cag gi ston mchog kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen 'di nyid kyi bstan pa la bris 'bur gnyis la bris sku kho na thog mar byung ste/ de'ang grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi gzugs can snying pos/ rgyal po u dra yā ṇa la skyes len du bskur ba ste/ gang gi tshe/

ri mo ba rnams kyis ston pa dngos kyi sku blta bas chog mi shes pa'i tshad blang ma spob par/ ston pa chu 'gram la bzhugs su gsol nas chu'i nang gi gzugs brnyan la dper byas nas bris pa bskur bas de la brten nas/ sgra sgrogs kyi yul der gtsug lag khang lnga brgya brtsigs te bstan pa dar ba dang*/ de rjes ston pas ras kyi gzhi la 'od bting ba ltar bris pa'i sku ste/ de ni siṅga la'i rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig 'khri shing can la bskur ba/ de la brten nas bu mos bden pa mthong ba'i lo rgyus sogs dang*/ de dag la brten nas yul gru kun du bris sku'i dar srol byung ba mdo sde rnams nas 'byung zhing*/ 'bur sku'i thog ma tsan+dan jo bo'i sku ste/ de ni bcom ldan 'das yum gyi don du lha gnas su gshegs pa na/ grong khyer gsal ldan gyi rgyal pos mchod pa'i yul du tsan+dan gyi rgyu las grub pa'i ston pa dngos dang 'dra ba'i sku bzheng bar 'dod pa na/ bzo bos ci 'dra ba bzhugs pa ma 'tshal te/ maud gal gyi bu'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas bzo bos lha yul du phyin nas ston pa ji ltar bzhugs pa mjal ba ltar bzhengs pa'i sku ste/ de ni da ltar ma hā tsi na'i yul du bzhugs pa sogs las 'phros nas/ zi'u thang sogs bris 'bur gyi sku dar rgyas su byung bar bshad do// bod 'dir bris sku dar ba'i thog ma ni/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan du ston pa dgung lo nyer lnga pa'i sku tshad bzhugs pa la dper byas nas/ rgya gar dang bal po'i bzo bos bris pa'i rgyun rgya gar dang bal po sogs la yod pa'i rgyun mched pas dang por bal ris kyi rgyun gtsang dbus kun du dar srol che ba byung*/ phyis su byon pa mkhas pa bkra shis rgyal po zhes bya bar slob ma rang las mkhas pa sman bla don grub ces bya ba byung ste/ rig pa'i gnas gzhan dang khyad par lha ris la shin tu mkhas par gyur te/

de nyid kyis dus 'khor dang sdom 'byung gi rgyud rtsa 'grel sogs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ sku gzugs kyi tshad kyi rab tu byed pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad bshad pa/ gzhung gzhan mi 'thad pa'i phyogs dgag pa/ tshad dang mi ldan pa'i skyon bshad pa/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung dgod pa/ tshad dang ldan pa'i yon tan brjod pa/ lha bzo dang sbyin bdag gi mtshan nyid bstan pa/ lag tu blang ba rim pa rgyas par bshad pa ste bdun gyis gtan la phab par mdzad de/ de las dar ba rnams la ni sman lugs zhes grags la/ yang gong dkar sgang stod nas/ mkhyen brtse chen po zhes bya ba'i lha ris la mkhas mthong chod pa zhig byon te/ de ni sman thang pa dang*/ ri mo'i lugs cung zad mi 'dra bas mkhyen lugs zhes grags pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ sprul sku bye'u thang pa zhes pa'i mkhas pa zhig ste/ de dag ni sman mkhyen gnyis dang*/ ri mo'i lugs srol cung zad mi mthun pas/ lugs srol gsum gyes pa las rim par mched de/ mdor na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa gang du dar ba de dang der/ bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i sku bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs shin tu dar ba byung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ bod chen gyi ljongs 'dir/ sngon dus kyi bal bris dang*/ sman mkhyen zung gi lugs la sogs pa/ ri mo'i lugs srol sna tshogs zhig dar ba'i rjes mchis pa las/ 'dir karma mi bskyod rdo rje'i dngos slob tu gyur cing*/ sman lugs rnying pa'i ri mo'i lugs srol gyi rjes su 'brang ba/ bla ma sangs rgyas lha dbang zhes bya ba bod chen ljongs kyi 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs su/ lha ris kyi tshad dang mtshan nyid la shin tu mkhas pa zhig byung ste/ de'i nying slob lta bur gyur pa/ lha bzo rta mgrin mgon po zhes bya ba byung ste/ de nas rim gyis mched pa la/

slar chos dbyings rgya mtsho sogs dang*/ lho brag pa sogs sman gsar pa'i lugs kyi ri mo'i rgyun yang 'dres pa'i srol bzung ba/ lha bzo ba dge slong ye shes blo gros dang*/ ye shes chos 'grub/ sangs rgyas rin chen dpon g.yog ste/ sku gzugs kyi tshad dang mtshan nyid la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i byang chub par mchis pa rnams btus shing bkrabs so// gsum pa ni/ spyir brtsam bya'i las thams cad kyi thog ma'i dus tshes dang*/ gza' skar sogs legs pa ni gegs med cing mthar phyin pa dang*/ bkra shis par 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad ma 'phyugs pa dgos te/ de'ang rab byung 'dod pa'i nang gsel la/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad du bi kra ma zhes bya ba/ stod 'grel las rnam par gnon pa ste/ ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khab tu ging shin zhes bod pa/ gangs ldan pa'i brdar/ dbang thang dang bstun pa'i 'bod phyogs su lcags kyi sgra brgya pa'i gnam lor/ 'tsho ba'i srog 'od srungs byin gyis brling bar byas pa la/ lus ni sra brtan lcags kyi rang bzhin du grub par/ rkang 'thung dbang po'i klung gi rta la rtsen zhing*/ pho brang gling dgu'i rgyal por yab lha gdal drug gis rtsen pa/ 'byung ba bzhi ldan srog dbang ma bur gyur pa'i sde zhig ste/ bkra shis kyi klung dang ldan pa'i bgrang gzhi shar ba'i zhag gi phung po/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs kyi dbyar rwa ba/ rgyu skar gyi lha mo sa gas nya ba/ nyin mor byed pa khyu mchog gi khyim du rtsen pa/ rten 'brel reg pa can/ hor lugs dang gso rig mthun par bzhi par bgrang ba/ bi shwa na ra'i bu'i lugs kyi dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa'i nyin/ lha'i bla ma sgrol byed sa ga'i bu mos thabs su bsu ba'i 'phrod chung me rlung*/ 'phrod chen 'phel ba 'dzom par/ lha ris pa rnams kyis gtso bo rnams kyi thig 'debs pa dang bcas 'dri ba'i 'go tshugs so// de nas brtsams te lha bzo pa rnams rang rang gis thob skal ltar/

sangs rgyas byang sems zhi drag gang yin gyi tshad dang mtshan nyid mthun par rnam g.yeng med par bris pas/ phyi rol sgo dang bcas pa hor zla lnga pa'i nyer lnga la gegs med du ri mo'i bgyi ba mthar phyin pa byung ngo*// smras pa/ skyabs yul dad gsum zhing sa gshin pa'i khrod// legs byas sa bon nyer btab smar zong gi /mthun rkyen chu lud kyis bskyed 'dod pa dgu'i// myu gu bskyed bsring sbyin bdag dbyar gyi dpal// gang tshe gtsug lag dang po'i rig pa'i gzhung*// rgyud 'grel dgongs pa'i drang thig las 'phos pa'i// snang brnyan sprul pa'i sman mkhyen mkhas pa dag /bod yul chen po'i ljongs 'dir lhags sam snyam// dus tshes yan lag lngas bsdus dge ba'i mdas// bar chad bden bral gzugs brgya bcil te slar// rten dang brten pa'i ngo mtshar gzugs brnyan gyi// yid 'phrog si tā khugs pa'i dga' ston rol// zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// gsum pa bskrun pa'i rten gyi bzhugs grangs ni/ lha khang gi logs bris kyi gtso chen bcu gsum bzhugs pa'i/ dbus kyi gtso chen la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ de'i g.yas logs nas rim par/ dang por gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ gnyis par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ gsum par rdo rje 'jigs byed/ bzhi par rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa/ lnga par rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa/ drug par tshe dpag tu med pa/ de'i mthar dpal tshogs kyi bdag po/ gtso bo'i g.yon logs nas rim par/ dang por gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam dpal rdo rje/ gnyis par 'khor lo bde mchog gsum par snying po kye rdo rje/ bzhi par bcom ldan 'das kun rig lnga par sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ drug par gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma rnams so// de dag gi 'khor du/ phugs logs kyi gong na dus gsum sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug paṇ+ḍi ta rgyan drug mchog gnyis/

grub chen brgyad/ rgyud sde so so'i bla ma brgyud pa rags rim 'ga' re dang*/ gsham du bde mchog sgyu ma chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa sogs rgyud sde'i lha rags btus rnams dang*/ g.yas logs kyi gong du/ bod du bstan pa la sku drin che ba'i bla ma rnams dang*/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa rim byon/ chos 'khor dgon gyi mkhan rabs kha shas dang*/ 'jam dpal dmar ser dang nag po/ rigs gsum mgon po sogs byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ 'og gi char/ dmag zor rgyal mo sogs bstan srung tshogs bdag gi 'khor du nor lha'i rigs dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun mchod rdzas kyi gzugs brnyan rnams dang*/ g.yon logs kyi gong du sa skya pa rnam gsum/ 'phags pa lha rim byon dang*/ dwags po lha rje/ bsrung ba lnga'i lha mo rnams dang*/ sman bla mched bdun dang*/ 'og gi char dur khrod bdag po/ mgon po phyag drug phyag bzhi/ gur mgon/ ma ning*/ zhang blon sogs bka' srung rnams bzhugs so// sgo'i phyi rol gyi gong du phyogs skyong bcu/ sgo 'gram la rgyal po chen po bzhi/ g.yas ngos la dge slong ma dpal mo lugs kyi spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal/ yul lha tshe sman rgyal mo mched lcam bdun/ g.yon ngos la slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i sku la mchod rdzas kyi bkod pa bcas dang*/ 'jam dpal phyag mtshan gyi ri mo/ sdom brtson dam pa zhes pa'i zhal byang dang bcas pa rnams te/ de dag kyang grub lo tsam ma yin par/ gong du smos pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams nas bstan pa'i tshad kyis gtan la phab ste/ de la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad tshon gyi rigs dang*/ gser dang gser shog sogs tshang bar sbyar te/ lus can kun gyis phyag mchod 'bul ba sogs/ bsod nams gsog pa'i rten du 'gyur nges dang*/ lha khang de nyid kyi rgyab tu/ sa snar rin po che bsres pa'i 'jim pa las grub pa'i par sku bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan stong dang sum cu rtsa gsum/

sgrol ma ljang gu sum cu so bdun bcas la'ang*/ nang gzungs rtsi tshon gsol ba dang bcas rnams lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslangs te bzhengs pa yin no// smras pa/ bkrag tu cher bkod mkha' dbyings mi ltung phreng*// tshar du dngar byed drang srong rnga bong gis// dkar 'jam zhal ba'i ngos gzhir lus can gyis// mchod yul gzugs brnyan bzo yi rig byed pas// bka' srol dngos brgyud bla ma mkhan rabs dang*// yi dam dpal stug sras slob bka' srung tshogs// gzugs rnams ri mor shar ba 'di mthong tshe// zhing khams rgya mtsho logs shig dmigs su ci// brgya phrag bsod nams rtsal gyis legs bskrun pa'i// dge legs mtshan spras rgyal ba'i sku gzugs dngos// skal dman dbang po'i yul du mthong 'di dang*// bsod nams phung po'i tshad la lci yang med// ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// bzhi pa bzhengs pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba la/ las byed pa mnyes par byas pa dang*/ rab tu gnas pa bgyis pa/ dge ba byang chub snying po'i rgyur bsngo ba ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ las byed kyi gtso bo bzo gnas rig pa'i gtsug lag 'dzin pa'i lha ris pa rnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i sku'i rten bskrun pa'i byed por/ thams cad kyis mchod kyin bkur ba'i gnas su shes nas yon gyis mnyes par byed dgos pa'ang*/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ bzo bo ma mnyes pa'i lha la ye shes pa mi 'jug ste/ rab gnas kyi thog mar bzo bo mnyes par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun par/ thog mar dbu 'dzugs ston mor dar kha/ mdzo hon thar bzang ba/ lha dpon dbu pa la dar kha wa lpags/ spyan 'byed kyi rnam gzhag la kha dar/ dngul ba la dong*/ thun mong du dar kha/ mdzo mo bcas/ 150 yon 'bul dbu pa la/ dar kha/ gzhan thams cad ja'i gang tshad la brtsi ba'i gos stod/ 070 ther sham legs pa/ 100 wa lpags/ 010 ga'u bzang ba/ 070 g.yag bzang ba/

040 zhwa snam bcas bdun tshan/ lha ris gzhan thun mong du dar kha/ rdo rje dril bu/ 010 dngul srang phyed lnga la ja/ 122 ja 'khor drug bzhi la bar khag chags/ chos gos/ 070 ras dmar nag yug 070 ral gri/ 030 skyogs rag kha can/ 010 mdzo bzang ba/ 200 bcas pa'i dgu tshan/ yang kha btags/ mdzo hon thar ma dar yol/ 130 ba mo/ 130 skyogs rag kha can/ 010 dung gi ske zhags/ 010 bcas lnga tshan/ yang ra g.yag 070 snam bu/ dung chab bcas/ 020 sum tshan te/ mdor na dbu ston legs 'bul yan chad khyon bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rtsis su bgrang ba dang*/ shing bzo la dar ras yug man tse kha gang*/ g.yos byed par ra gcig 040 dar kha/ rdza bkram tshang la tir ru/ ye shes tshe ring la ral gri/ karma la mar rgya gang*/ ye shes tshe ring la ja sbags/ dpon la ja sbags/ chos khrims la ja sbags/ ja ma mar nyag chu len la chab ma bcas rnams byin par/ thams cad nas dgyes shing tshim par gyur te/ mdor na dngos rdzas nyung zad tsam gyi bsod nams sa bon gyi 'brel 'jog bgyis pa thams cad chud 'dza' ma song bar rten bzhengs 'di nyid kyi cha rkyen du 'gro bar bgyis zin to// gnyis pa ni/ rten bzhengs mthar phyin nas rab tu gnas pa'i cho gas byin gyis brlabs par ma byas par yun ring du gnas na mi shes par 'byung ba dang*/ de srid du mchod pa'i 'os su mi 'gyur bar bshad de/ ji skad du/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa dag /byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na// de las bkra mi shes 'gyur zhing*// de srid mchod pa der mi 'os// zhes gsungs pas/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga brtsams te/ de'ang*/ rten dang slob dpon dus dang gnas// yo byad cho ga bzang po drug /ces 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga sgrub par byed pa'i/ rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya bas mtshon pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga la mkhas pa'i bla ma dge slong dpon slob rnams bsags te/

gsang ba 'dus pa'am/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga yang dag pas/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan gyi rnam pa re re la'ang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i yon tan gyi bkod pa rdzogs par byin gyis brlabs zin pas/ slan chad thar pa 'dod pa'i skye bo gang dag gis/ gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa// de yi mdun na thub pa bzhugs// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ rten rnams phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa'i dbang po sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i tshogs dang*/ bka' sdod chos skyong ba'i srung bar bcas pa'i rang bzhin du nges pa'i 'du shes dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas/ me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ mar me la sogs pa'i mchod pas mdun bdar te/ phyag mchod dang*/ bskor ba bkur stir bgyis pas/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus bsod nams dpag tu med pa'i tshogs rdzogs kyi snying po can du 'gyur ba ni gor ma chag ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phrin las kyi rgyun dang*/ smon lam gyi mthu las byung ba nyid kyi phyir ro// gsum pa dge ba yongs su bsngo ba la gsum ste/ bsngo bya'i dge ba/ bsngo ba'i rnam par gzhag pa/ bsngo ba dngos so// dang po ni dbye na/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ste gsum las/ 'dir dang po nyid de/ spyir stobs bcu mnga' ba shākya'i sras kyi bstan pa 'di la/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyad pa spyod pas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ gnas skabs su dbul phongs kyi 'jigs pa las bsgral nas/ lha mi'i bde 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i rgyu sbyin pa la 'bad par bya dgos te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ zas skom mal stan gos mchog dang*// phreng ba gnas dang rgyan rnams dang*// grags pa yon tan khyad 'phags pa// de kun sbyin las byung bar gsungs// ngag snyan mdzes dang longs spyod dang*// khyad par 'phags gzugs yangs pa dang*// tshig snyan gzi ldan yid 'ong dag

/grags dang nad med tshe dag ste// yid 'ong sdug pa de dang de// sbyin pa rnams kyi 'bras bu yin// zhes pa nas/ srid gsum mi bzad 'jigs chen la// sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog med// ces pa'i bar rgya cher bstan cing*/ khyad par de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang mchod rten gyi rigs bskrun pa'i ched du sbyin pa byin pa'i bsod nams ni/ mkhas mchog de nyid kyis/ sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhengs gsol ba// dang por mya ngan sel bar byed// rtsod pa kun spangs mthong na dga'// skal ldan gter tshogs dpal dang ldan// lus stobs ldan zhing snyan pa dang*// gzi brjid ldan zhing gzugs mdzes la// gsung rab kun la mkhas 'gyur zhing*// dbang po'i rta ni thams cad thul// blo ldan gtong dang ldan par 'gyur// bcom ldan sku gzugs mchod rten la// phra rab rdul ni ji snyed song*// de snyed sa 'og sa steng 'dir// de snyed rgyal por nges par 'gyur// gzugs dang gzugs med ting nge 'dzin// thams cad bde ba ma lus spyod// tha mar skye rga'i rgud spangs nas// de dag byang chub go 'phang thob// ces sogs mang du gsungs pas/ zang zing gi dngos po snying po med pa las/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu gzugs sku gnyis 'grub pa'i bar gyi rgyu yon tan gyi zhing du gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten bzhengs pa la brten nas bsod nams tshogs bsags kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// lha khang 'di nyid kyi ched du dmigs nas byung ba'i smar zong gi dngos po'i gtong ba gong du smos pa rnams dang*/ der ma zad sgo gsum gyi 'bad rtsol dang las kyi 'brel thogs dang bcas pa'i rgyud la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa mchis pa rnams so// gnyis pa rnam par gzhag pa la/ bsngo ba'i dgos pa/ bsngo ba'i yul/ ji ltar bsngo ba'i tshul te gsum las/ dang po ni/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bzhengs pa'i rgyu sbyor ba/

bya byed 'brel thogs thams cad kyi rgyud la dge tshogs dpag tu med pa yod mod/ de dag kyang bar ma dor chud mi 'dza' zhing*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sa bon du 'phel zhing stobs dang ldan par bsgyur ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab dgos te/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung*// rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad// de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang*// byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ tshe 'di'i bde rgyu tsam dang*/ phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang*/ rang don du zhi bde nyan rang byang chub don du gnyer ba'i phyir ma yin par/ gzhan don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ste/ mgon po byams pas/ khams gsum rtog pa ma yin dang*// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon te/ dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad sems can kun dang thun mong du byas te bsngo dgos te/ zhi ba'i lhas/ dngos sam yang na brgyud kyang rung*// sems can don las gzhan mi spyad// sems can kho na'i don gyi phyir// thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes so// de'ang dngos po dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ yul te 'khor gsum po yongs su dag pa'i tshul gyis bsngo ste/ sdud pa las/ gal te 'di ltar chos 'di 'gags shing zad pa dang*// gang du yongs su bsngo ba de yang zad pa dang*// chos kyis chos la nam yang mi bsngo shes gyur na// de ltar rab tu shes pas yongs su bsngos pa yin// zhes so// de ltar rnam par gzhag pa la mkhas pa des yongs su bsngos na bsod nams thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba mi bslu ba ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi khyad par gyi chos te/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ bsod nams byas pa'i tshogs dag ni// sems can rnams la yongs bsngo ba// bcom ldan khyod kyis gang gsungs pa// de gzhan bstan bcos las ma bshad// ces bshad pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa skabs su bab pa'i bsngo ba dngos ni/

sar+b+ba pra ṇi dhiḥsid+dhi rastu/ a ho mu med phyogs kyi bzhin yangs par// yid srubs thul mchog zhing gi bkod pa'i bzhin// gang dag shar ba thams cad rnam dkar gyi// dge tshogs yongs bsngo grub pa'i dpang por gsol// 'di na legs bris gtso dang ltos 'phye dbang*// dri za mi bdag che sogs 'jig rten na// cher rlom kun gyi gtsug gis btud pa'i yul// bslu med skyabs kyi yongs rtse dkon mchog gsum// de dag phrin las lhun grub srid pa 'dir// rten dang brten pa'i rnam par legs shar bas// 'gro don rgyun chags 'byung ba rten gsum gyis// mngon par gtams 'di bzhengs pa'i legs byas dang*// skyes ba'i phreng bar kun slong dug bral gyis// kun nas bsags pa'i bsod nams gangs ri dang*// skye 'phags byang chub spyod pa'i sprin chen las// dge tshogs kha ba'i rdul tshogs brtsegs par bcas// 'khor gsum dmigs med sgyu ma'i nyi 'od kyis// tshogs gnyis zhi bsil dag byed rgyun bsgyur bas// thub pa'i bka' don smra dbang btsong kha pa'i// ring lugs chu gter rab tu rgyas phyir bsngo// de tshul klog spong 'khor lo lhur len pa'i// chos 'dul 'dzin pa'i 'dus tshogs cher rgyas pa// khu byug bung ba'i mgrin rnga 'bum 'khrol bas// gur gum nags su rtsen bzhin mdzes par mdzod// ljongs 'dis nyer mtshon yul grur 'khod dgu yi// skye 'gro phan tshun mdza' gcugs dge ba bcur// spyod kyin bde 'byor rgyas pa rdzogs ldan gyi// dum bu 'di na 'phos bzhin dge gyur cig /rten bzhengs tshul 'dir rgyu rdzas sbyor brtson gyi// 'brel thogs kyis mtshon sems can kun gyi rgyud// tshogs zung spyod pa'i chu klung yongs btung ba'i// yon tan rgya mtsho rgyal ba'i sku thob shog /nam zhig brgya phrag bsod nams byed po yis// bgrang yas bskal pa'i pir rtse bsgyur ba las// legs 'khrungs dge legs mtshan bzang so gnyis dang*// dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa'i sku thob shog

/de srid skye bar mi khom gnas brgyad kyis// rnam dben dal brgyad 'byor bcu rdzogs pa'i lus// thob nas rgyal gsungs yang dag smra ba'i bshes// rtag par mnyam 'grogs dge bcur spyod par shog /bstan pa'i gzhi ma tshul khrims bslab dang ldan// phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung lugs thos pas 'byor// thos don dpyod dang bsgom byung blo gros kyis// lung rtogs bstan la mkhas pa'i las byed shog /mar gyur lus can srid pa'i duḥkha las// bsgral 'dod bla med byang chub 'dod pa'i blo// ches cher bskyed cing brtse dang byang chub sems// zung 'jug spyod pa'i rgya mtshor slob par shog /dpal mgrin mgo skyes bkrus pa'i dri ma med// drang srong drag gtum kha chus ma bslad pa'i// rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam smin grol gyi// skal ldan dam tshig sdom pa la gnas shog /sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do'i lcags kyi khams// sbyong byed lam byed rnam bzhi'i rtsi chen gyis// 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gser// mngon gyur 'gro ba'i re ba 'gengs par shog /gzhan don lhag bsam gyis bskyed gzhi lam dang*// 'bras bu'i skabs kyi mngon 'dod smon lam du// bgyis pa'i snye ma g.yur du za ba nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas smin gyur cig /ces so// 'dir smras pa/ srid pa kun du gzhar yang bslu med dkon mchog gsum// skyabs su bzung ba'i bslab bya'i yan lag sku gsung thugs// gzugs brnyan tshul gyis 'gro don byed pa sprul pa'i skus// mngon par gtams pa'i khang bzang bsod nams zhing du bskrun// de nyid las 'phros gleng ba tshogs gsum dngar ba 'dir// sna tshogs brjod bya'i chu khur lang ling 'khrigs pa'i khrod// rjod byed rgyan gsum dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldir ba la// mos ldan yid kyi mdongs mtha' kun dga'i gar bsgyur cig /'dir 'bad 'khor ba'i phun tshogs sgrub pa'i so nam min// ming tshig yi ge khe bun spel ba'i dran gso min// gang phyir dkon mchog dgyes 'gyur dge ba'i las bsgrubs pa'i// ngo mtshar gleng ba'i snyan dngags brtsams la spro ba brtas// dge bas ma bos srid par 'phyan pa'i lus can rnams// ma bcol na yang nyer btud phan dang bde ster ba// ma bteg skye dgu'i bla mar mngon mtho rgyal bstan gyi// nor bu bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor brling gyur cig

/kho bo ltos 'brel gzhan don rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// 'on te rgyu tshogs ma tshang de srid skye ba kun// dal 'byor rten ldan sangs rgyas chos tshogs skyabs su thob// gtsug lag kun rig bstan la mkhas pa'i las byed shog /ces dga' ldan rnam rgyal gling lha khang gi rten bzhengs las 'phros pa'i gleng ba dbyar gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rnam par dpyod ldan blo bzang shes rab kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes grags pa'i bgrang gzhi'i zhag gi phung po gser ri'i grangs ldan gyi gral tshes dge ba'i nyin sug bris su bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
